turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail: review: 1. Submit a request through the Return Portal. 2. Select “Item was damaged” as the reason. 3. Upload clear images showing the damage. Our team will review the submission within 2–3 business days and provide a resolution. This applies when the order is within the return period. If the item is final sale, non-returnable, or outside the return period, the request should include the order number, item name, and clear images of the damage. You can also review the return and exchange policies.
